1.text: You began your journey at the broken gates of a fort in some distant misty and cold mountains. You stepped inside to begin your journey.

2.text: Once inside you reached yet another archway. A doorless opening seemingly going further into the fort.

choices.text: You reached a decision. Two doorways stood infront of you barely distinct from each other. The opening to the left seemed to be brighter and this made you feel safe. You entered it.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You reached a decision. Two doorways stood infront of you barely distinct from each other. The opening to the right seemed darker and this intriged you. You entered it.
choices.label: Continue this way

4.text: You approached the doorway and felt a cold breeze. This didn't deter you so you continued forward.

5.text: You approached the doorway and heard a whistling breeze pass through. This peaked your curiosity and you continue forward.

6.text: The doorway led directly into a dark mountain path. With the air damp and the rocks wet you continued forward.

7.text: Once you turned the corner of the rocky path you were comforted by the sight of another man-made doorway. You confidently entered.

8.text: After entering the door you see more structures but this time not something you can pass through. You hugged this wall as you continued forward.

9.text: Luckily this wall did not lead to a dead end. It continued into more dark and damp rocks which you hesitently passed through.

choices.text: This path led you to a split in the path. The path to the left felt correct so you continued this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: This path led you to a split in the path. The path to the right felt correct so you continued this way.
choices.label: Continue this way

11.text: As you moved further to the right you saw the distant image of yet another man-made gateway. You approach hoping it leads your goal.

12.text: With the sun peaking over the mountain and lighting up the gate you felt as if you were being pointed in the direction you needed to go. You continued forward.

13.text: The sunlit stone made you lose all discomfort the wet damp rock made you feel. There was comfort in where you were in your journey. You enter the arch.

14.text: This led to tighter mountain paths but with your newfound comfort you felt strong in continuing your journey.

15.text: The path seemed endless but you felt that you were almost there. You pushed forward knowing the end is near.

16.text: A descreet cave entrance appeared and after a short breather you crawl through knowing you filled with both hesitation and excitment.
16.note: Placeholder text — hands off to the shared ending sequence once it's added.

17.text: As you looked to the left you relised you were on the other side of the wall you saw earlier. Knowing others had been here made you feel safe and you continued forward.

18.text: This wall led to more wet rock walls. However this path led to something more open. Something away from the tight passages you were used to.

19.text: This opening looked as if it led to only one way with yet another wall blocking a potential path. So you continued forward.

choices.text: You moved forward and relised this wall was not a blockade but another path you could have taken. Although possible to squeeze through you felt the wider, rocky path was the way to go.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You moved forward and relised this wall was not a blockade but another path to take. With this knowledge you decided to risk the tighter passage over the wider rocky path.
choices.label: Continue this way

21.text: The path led to more and more rocks with no defining feature. Although the fear of getting lost passed your mind, your willingness to reach your goal outweighed this.

22.text: You approached the passage as saw barely noticable differences in either side of the walls. You felt that these were entrances so you pushed forward to confirm your suspicions.

choices.text: You were correct and before you was a choice of left or right. Nothing was visible to sway you either way so you decisivly chose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You were correct and before you was a choice of left or right. Nothing was visible to sway you either way so you decisivly chose right.
choices.label: Continue this way

24.text: Your sharp turn to the right led directly into more rock. The sight of this made you fustrated with the idea that you were making no progress. Despite this you pushed forward.

25.text: As you pushed through another wall peaked above the rocks. This looked different than the others you had seen so you fustrations subsided.

26.text: The sunlight was hitting this wall as if it was a marker pointing you in the right direction. With this feeling you hasterly passed through.

27.text: This led to a mountian path in which the rocks were sparkling with the reflection of sunlight. You continued forward feeling in awe of your surroundings.

28.text: Upon turning the corner you hit a stone wall which felt like it was telling you that you were not welcome here. Despite this you pushed through to the rocky path ahead.

29.text: Pushing forward you see another wall in the distance however this one had an open gate you approached feeling this was the way you needed to go.

choices.text: After continuing forward you came to a suprise decision. To the left a damp, dark and misty rocky path and the right a gateway with no telling what was ahead. You went left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: After continuing forward you came to a suprise decision. To the left a damp, dark and misty rocky path and the right a gateway with no telling what was ahead. You went right.
choices.label: Continue this way

31.text: This path was the darkest of the entire journey. Although not knowing where this could reach you decided it was important to stick with your gut.

32.text: The darkness became brightness as gaps in the rocks allowed the sun shine through. Being able to see the path ahead filled you will confidence in continuing forward.

33.text: Sunlight disappeared again and you found yourself in another stretch of darkness. You realised you couldn't be confident in anything that came next.

34.text: Finally the path changed from damp winding paths to an open plateau. You continued forward.

35.text: As you pushed forward you saw a small gap which you didn't know if it was something more that just that. You approached to investigate.

36.text: Approaching the door you felt an anxious feeling which could have been excitment or fear. Regardless you pushed through archway.

37.text: This path felt direct. There wasn't much to it your anxious feeling continued and you walked forward.

38.text: What seemed straight forward now became an open plateau with no distinct path forward. You did however notice a small gap infront which was you only option so you investigated.

39.text: Choosing left led to open cortyard with nothing in it, much like the openings you started you journey with. The only way forward was a doorway so you entered.

40.text: This path felt weird. A passage squeezed between two walls leading into a tight, barely passable gap. Despite the wrongness of this you pushed forward and squeezed through.

41.text: This led to a plateau with no distinct path forward. There was however a small gap you could just make out. You approached to see if it led anywhere.
